text: Fastmail Privacy Policy. We collect your email address and payment information to provide email hosting services. We do not use your data to train any AI or machine learning models. We do not sell or share your personal data with advertisers or third parties for their commercial benefit. We retain your data for 30 days after account deletion, then permanently delete it. You retain full ownership of all content you store with us. Our policy is clear and consistent: your data is used only to operate your mailbox.

Tutanota Privacy Notice. We store encrypted emails and your account credentials. No personal data is processed for AI training purposes. We do not share user data with third parties or advertisers. After account deletion, all data is purged within 30 days. You own all content in your mailbox. We use end-to-end encryption; our policy is written plainly and does not contradict itself.

Obsidian Privacy Policy. Obsidian is a local-first application. We do not collect your notes or vault contents. Sync and publish features are optional and use end-to-end encryption. We do not use your data for AI training. We do not sell data to third parties. Account data is deleted within 14 days of cancellation. You retain all intellectual property rights to your notes. Our terms are concise and unambiguous.

Mozilla Firefox Privacy Notice. Firefox is a browser that processes data locally on your device. We collect crash reports and usage telemetry only with your consent. We do not use your browsing data to train AI models. We do not sell personal data to advertisers or data brokers. Sync data is deleted within 30 days of account closure. You own all your bookmarks and browsing data. Our notice is written clearly and consistently.

Kagi Privacy Policy. We do not track searches or build user profiles. We do not use search queries for AI training. We do not sell any user data to third parties. Account data is deleted within 30 days of cancellation. You retain ownership of any content you provide. Our policy is concise and contains no ambiguous or contradictory language.

Anthropic Privacy Policy and Usage Policy. We collect conversations you have with Claude and other Anthropic products. By default, conversations may be used to improve our models and AI safety research unless you opt out through your account settings. The opt-out is available in Settings > Privacy. We do not sell personal data to third parties or advertisers. Conversation data is retained for up to 90 days after account deletion for safety review, then deleted. You retain ownership of your inputs; Anthropic does not claim intellectual property rights over content you submit. Our policy clearly describes data flows with no contradictory statements.

OpenAI Privacy Policy. We collect API inputs, outputs, and conversation history. Your inputs may be used to train and improve our models unless you opt out via the data controls in your account dashboard or via the API header parameter. We do not sell personal data to data brokers or advertisers. Content submitted through the API is not used for training by default; ChatGPT free-tier conversations may be used for training unless opted out. We retain data for up to 90 days after account deletion. You retain ownership of the content you submit. We share usage analytics with Stripe for billing and with Datadog for monitoring; these are service providers and not third-party advertisers.

WhatsApp Privacy Policy. WhatsApp is part of the Meta family of companies. We collect your phone number, contacts, profile information, messages (end-to-end encrypted), usage logs, device identifiers, and location data when you share it. We share information across Meta companies including Facebook and Instagram to improve ads targeting, product recommendations, and safety systems. We do not use message content for advertising because messages are end-to-end encrypted. We retain account information for up to 90 days after deletion. You retain ownership of your content. By using WhatsApp you agree to data sharing with Meta's advertising infrastructure.

Apple Privacy Policy. Apple collects purchase history, device identifiers, iCloud content, Siri voice data, and usage statistics. Apple does not sell your personal data to third parties or advertisers. Siri requests are analyzed to improve voice recognition; you can opt out of Siri improvement in Settings. iCloud data is retained for 180 days after account deletion. Apple claims a limited, non-exclusive license to your iCloud content solely to provide the service. Our policy is clear and does not contradict itself.

Microsoft Privacy Statement (Microsoft 365). Microsoft collects diagnostic data, usage telemetry, document metadata, and contact information. Microsoft does not sell personal data. Diagnostic data may be used to improve Microsoft products including AI features in Copilot; you can opt out via privacy settings. We share data with authorized Microsoft resellers and support partners who act as service providers under contractual obligations. Retained data is deleted within 180 days of subscription cancellation. You retain full ownership of your documents and data. Connected experiences in Microsoft 365 analyze your content locally to provide recommendations; this analysis is not shared with third parties.

Meta Privacy Policy. We collect information you provide (name, email, photos, videos, messages), information about your activity (content you view, purchases, time spent), device information (hardware model, OS, IP address, unique identifiers), and location data. We also collect information from third-party partners including data brokers, advertising networks, and analytics companies to supplement our profile of you. We use this information for advertising including showing ads based on your interests, behaviors, and inferred characteristics. We share your information with advertisers, measurement partners, marketing partners, and third-party applications you connect to Facebook. Your information may be used to train AI models that power features like face recognition, content recommendations, and automatic translations. We may retain data for up to 3 years after account deletion to comply with legal obligations and for safety purposes. You grant Meta a non-exclusive, transferable, sub-licensable, royalty-free, worldwide license to use any content you post on or in connection with Facebook. This license extends beyond platform operation to include product research, safety, and integrity purposes. Our policy spans multiple interconnected documents and practices described at different levels of specificity, which together govern how data is used.

Google Privacy Policy. Google collects information you create or provide (Gmail content, Drive files, search queries, YouTube watch history), information from your use of Google services (location, searches, voice and audio, purchase history, contact lists, Calendar events, photos), information from third-party sources (advertising partners, partner sites using Google services), and information from your devices. We use this data to provide and improve services, serve personalized advertising, and conduct research. Google shares personal information with other companies in Alphabet, our partners (including advertisers), companies that use our advertising and analytics tools, and domain administrators for Google Workspace accounts. Your data may be used to train Google's AI and machine learning models including Gemini. We retain different data for different periods; some data may be retained for the life of your account unless you delete it. When you upload content to Google services, you grant Google a worldwide, royalty-free license to use, host, store, reproduce, modify, create derivative works, communicate, publish, publicly perform, publicly display and distribute such content. We may use this license for any purpose connected to our products and services or for promoting Google.

X Privacy Policy. We collect information you provide when creating an account (name, email, phone number, date of birth), content you post (tweets, replies, likes, bookmarks), direct messages, and information about your device and location. We use advertising and analytics partners including third-party companies to serve personalized ads. Your public posts and interactions are shared with advertising partners for targeting purposes. Your data including posts and interactions may be used to train AI models powering Grok and other X AI features; you can opt out of this in Privacy Settings > Data sharing and personalization. We retain account data for 30 days after deletion before permanent removal; however, public posts may be retained in our systems for up to 18 months for analytics. You grant X a worldwide, non-exclusive, royalty-free license to use, copy, reproduce, process, adapt, modify, publish, transmit, display, and distribute your content, for any purpose including commercial purposes and sublicensing to third parties.

TikTok Privacy Policy. We collect profile information, user content (videos, audio, photos, text), messages, purchase information, and payment card details. We collect technical and behavioral information including device identifiers, keystroke patterns, clipboard content, location data, and browsing history within the app. We collect information from third-party advertising partners, data analytics companies, and social media platforms you connect to TikTok. Your data is used to serve personalized advertisements; we share data with advertising partners, analytics partners, and measurement companies. Your content and data may be used to train AI models including content recommendation and video understanding systems. We may retain data for up to 18 months after account deletion. You grant TikTok an irrevocable, perpetual, transferable, sub-licensable, royalty-free, worldwide license to use, reproduce, modify, adapt, publish, translate, create derivative works from, and distribute your content for any purpose including commercial uses beyond platform operation. We reserve the right to change this policy and your continued use constitutes acceptance.

Instagram Privacy Policy (Meta). Instagram is part of Meta. We collect photos, videos, and captions you post, messages you send, your followers and who you follow, hashtags you use, and your location. We receive information about you from advertising partners and data brokers which we combine with your Instagram activity. We use this to serve you personalized ads; your information is shared with Meta's advertising network, third-party measurement companies, and marketing partners. Your content and interactions may be used to train Meta's AI systems including image recognition and recommendation models. We retain account data for 30 days after deletion; however, content shared with others or content that appears in their accounts may persist beyond this period. By posting content on Instagram you grant Meta a non-exclusive, royalty-free, transferable, sublicensable, worldwide license to host, use, distribute, modify, run, copy, publicly perform or display, translate, and create derivative works of your content for any Meta product or service.

YouTube Privacy Policy (Google). YouTube is a Google product. We collect watch history, search history, comments, channel subscriptions, playlists, purchase history, payment information, and location. We collect data from third-party advertisers and analytics providers. We share data with advertisers who use YouTube ad services, Google's advertising partners, and with other Google products. YouTube watch history and comments may be used to train AI and machine learning models including content recommendation systems and video understanding AI. Google retains data for different periods depending on the type; some account data may be kept for the life of your account or until you delete it; analytics data may be retained indefinitely in aggregated form. When you upload content to YouTube you grant Google a worldwide, royalty-free, non-exclusive license to use, reproduce, distribute, prepare derivative works of, display, and perform the content in connection with the service and Google's business, including for promoting and redistributing part or all of the service in any media formats.

Amazon Privacy Notice. We collect name, address, payment information, purchase history, browsing history, device information, voice recordings from Alexa, and content interactions. We share information with third-party sellers who fulfill your orders, logistics partners, advertising partners (Amazon DSP), and analytics providers. Amazon uses purchase data and browsing history to power personalized advertising both on and off Amazon platforms through our advertising services. Voice recordings from Alexa may be reviewed by human reviewers to improve voice recognition; you can opt out of human review. We retain account data for 7 years after account closure to meet tax and regulatory obligations. You retain ownership of content you upload to Amazon services such as photos or reviews. Our policy is generally consistent but some provisions differ between Amazon.com, AWS, and Alexa.

Uber Privacy Notice. We collect your name, email, phone number, payment information, trip history, GPS location during trips, device information, and contacts if you grant access. We share data with drivers who accept your rides, restaurants that fulfill Uber Eats orders, and third-party analytics providers. We share your data with advertising partners to deliver targeted ads on and off the Uber app; these partners may combine Uber data with data from other sources. We do not use ride data to train AI models for commercial sale. Account data is retained for 7 years after account deletion to meet financial regulatory requirements and for safety purposes. You retain ownership of content you submit such as reviews or photos. Our terms are generally clear about how trip and payment data is used.

Airbnb Privacy Policy. We collect profile information, ID verification documents, payment details, booking history, messages with hosts and guests, reviews, and location. We share data with hosts and guests as necessary to complete bookings, with payment processors, and with identity verification providers. We do not sell personal data to data brokers or advertisers. We do not use your data to train AI models for commercial purposes. Account data is deleted within 90 days of account closure; however, ID verification documents may be retained for up to 1 year to comply with legal requirements. You retain ownership of reviews and photos you post; by posting you grant Airbnb a non-exclusive, worldwide license to use them on the Airbnb platform. Our policy is written in plain language and is consistent across sections.

Snapchat Privacy Policy. We collect Snaps, Stories, messages, search queries, location data, contact lists, device information, and behavioral data. We share information with advertising partners, measurement companies, and third-party analytics providers to serve personalized ads. Snap shares data with its advertising partners Snap Audience Network including third-party companies for ad targeting purposes. Snap may use your content and behavioral data to train AI models including My AI and visual recognition features. We retain account data for 30 days after deletion; however, Snaps sent to others may persist in recipient accounts. You grant Snap a worldwide, perpetual, royalty-free, sublicensable, and transferable license to host, store, use, display, reproduce, modify, adapt, edit, publish, and distribute your content for any purpose including commercial uses and promotions. Our data sharing practices are described at a general level; specific advertising partner lists are available on request.
